messages:
Maya Patel: quick question — our CI runners are starting ssh-agent and exporting AGENT_SOCK, then a failing job prints env and that value ends up in our Sentry logs. is the socket path sensitive? should we treat it like a secret?

Leo Chen: short answer: yes, treat it as sensitive. socket path itself could be abused on the same host if an attacker has access. we should avoid ever logging it.

Maya Patel: example log snippet from yesterday:
```
export AGENT_SOCK=/tmp/ssh-XXXXXX/agent.2222
USER=root
CI=true
```
that exact line was in the artifact zip.

Samir Rao: +1 no socket paths in logs. we should: 1) stop printing full env on failures 2) mask AGENT_SOCK in runner config 3) switch to Vault-issued ephemeral ssh certs for prod deploys where possible.

Jen O'Neill: re: approvals — if we change runner masking that's ops work only; if we switch key storage or change how deploy keys are provisioned we need eng-infra + security signoff. @Samir can you put an RFC/PR?

SecurityBot: policy reminder — do not commit private keys, do not log socket paths or key material. Approved mitigations: ephemeral certs, Vault SSH role/session OR agent-forwarding only from trusted bastion with strict ACLs. See: https://redwood.internal/security/secrets-handling#ssh

Leo Chen: quick mitigation steps I can do today:
- remove `env` dump in failure handler (PR in 10m)
- add masking rule in CI: `mask: [AGENT_SOCK, SSH_AUTH_SOCK]`
- sanitize archived artifacts to strip lines matching `/agent\.[0-9]+/`

Maya Patel: that would help. longer term we want to stop forwarding agents from ephemeral builders into prod. leaning to Vault SSH or short-lived deploy keys via KMS-wrapped secrets.

Samir Rao: I'll open the RFC: title "ephemeral-ssh-vault-proxy-for-ci" and include rollout plan + access matrix. proposed matrix: dev builds -> agent-forwarding allowed; staging/prod -> no agent-forwarding, use vault-ssh. approvals: eng-infra lead + security + platform SRE.

Jen O'Neill: who owns the urgent masking change? @Leo Chen? once merged I'll trigger a redeploy of the runner image.

Leo Chen: taking it now. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ci-runners/pull/412 (WIP) — includes regex scrub and env mask.

Maya Patel: thanks. one more: is it okay to keep AGENT_SOCK as an env var in memory for the job (not persisted anywhere)?

SecurityBot: Allowed if never written to persistent storage and never printed. Ensure artifact collection excludes it and Sentry scrubbing is configured. Audit note: add a rule to detect `/tmp/ssh-` patterns in artifacts for 30 days.

Samir Rao: noted — I'll add the audit rule to the RFC and assign reviewers.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: runner image rebuild queued (job #8765). will update once PR passes CI. :rocket:

Maya Patel: great, thanks everyone. Filing follow-ups: 1) Leo — masking PR, 2) Samir — RFC + approvals, 3) Jen — coordinate redeploy + confirm artifact scrub.

Leo Chen: ping me in #eng-sre if redeploy needs smoke tests.

Maya Patel: closing the loop here, will update the ticket once RFC is posted. :thumbsup:
